findings.current: And no sane person, no matter how rich, would invest it in a weapon.
findings.defect: Reverses where a sane person would use the rare metal.
findings.rationale: The source says a sensible person would put the metal toward making a weapon, rather than a mere storage chest.
findings.replacement: And no matter how rich you were, any sane person would use it to forge a weapon.
findings.source: 아무리 돈이 많아도 정상인이라면 무기를 만드는 데 투자하는 물건.

findings.current: Oh, His Highness the Crown Prince asked me to tell you this.
findings.defect: Crown Prince implies the emperor’s son; 황태제 identifies his younger brother as heir.
findings.rationale: The title preserves both the familial relationship and the succession status expressed by 황태제.
findings.replacement: Oh, His Highness the Emperor’s Brother and Heir asked me to tell you this.
findings.source: 아, 황태제 전하께서 이 말을 전해 달래.

findings.current:
> **System**
>
> **[Very Sturdy Iron Chest] acquired.**
>
> **New Item acquired. Would you like to appraise the Item and view its information?**
findings.defect: The notices retain source-style square brackets and bold entire messages, contrary to the specified System-panel format.
findings.rationale: The System heading and blockquote already frame the notices; neither brackets nor whole-notice bolding is needed.
findings.replacement:
> **System**
>
> Very Sturdy Iron Chest acquired.
>
> New Item acquired. Would you like to appraise the Item and view its information?
findings.source:
- [매우 단단한 철궤]를 습득하셨습니다.

- 새로운 아이템을 습득하셨습니다. 아이템을 감정하여 정보를 확인하시겠습니까?

findings.defect: The item name retains square brackets inside a System window.
findings.rationale: The binding Markdown rule excludes square-bracket framing from System UI terms.

findings.current: His sly trap snapped me out of my daze.
findings.defect: Calling it Hong Jin’s sly trap makes the awkward exchange sound deliberately engineered and drops the narrator’s realization that his own question backfired.
findings.rationale: The Tallulah-trap reference describes the speaker stumbling into an insensitive remark and recognizing it too late.
findings.replacement: Realizing how badly my question had backfired snapped me to my senses.
findings.source: 그리고 탈룰라의 덫에 걸려 정신이 번쩍 든 나는

summary: One sentence reverses the logic of the chest’s value; the draft also misidentifies a royal title and departs from the required System-panel format.
